lines.text: مسافران و امن و رفاهیت و مزید و فربهی حیوانات و زینت و ارایش و ساختن
lines.en: travelers, and security and comfort, and the increase and fatness of animals, and the adornment and decoration and building

lines.text: زمینها و ارزانی طعام در ولایت خاصه برنج و گندم و حسن حال اهل بازار و قوت
lines.en: of lands, and the cheapness of food in the province, especially rice and wheat, and the good condition of the people of the bazaar, and the strength

lines.text: حال اشراف و وزراء و رونق کار عوام الناس و ایمنی راهها و اخبار ساره و انشا
lines.en: of the condition of the nobles and viziers, and the prosperity of the affairs of the common people, and the safety of the roads, and glad tidings, and the creation

lines.text: وضع حمل و حدوث باران در وقت و اعتدال هوا و بقول بعضی حرب و قحط و جوع
lines.en: of pregnancy, and the occurrence of rain in its time, and the moderation of the weather, and according to the saying of some, war and famine and hunger

lines.text: عظیم باشد اگر مشتری بود فراخی سال بود و باران در وقت و اگر قمر مستعلی بود
lines.en: will be great. If it is Jupiter, there will be abundance in the year and rain in its time, and if the Moon is elevated,

lines.text: بسیاری رعد و برق و باران بود در وقت (و اگر در اسد بود) دلالت کند بر عزت
lines.en: there will be much thunder and lightning and rain in its time. (And if it is in Leo), it indicates the honor

lines.text: و بزرگی طلب کردن عامه و خرید و فروخت جواهر و امد و شد مسافران و بخار و تموج
lines.en: and greatness sought by the common people, and the buying and selling of jewels, and the coming and going of travelers, and vapor and the surging

lines.text: هوا و رونق حال بزرگان و سلامتی خواتین و خدم و راستی در خلایق و اطاعت ملوک
lines.en: of the air, and the prosperity of the condition of the great ones, and the safety of ladies and servants, and truthfulness among the creatures, and obedience to kings,

lines.text: نمودن و روانی نقود و اگر مشتری مستعلی بود هوا خشک گذرد و اگر قمر مستعلی بود
lines.en: and the circulation of cash. And if Jupiter is elevated, the weather will pass dry, and if the Moon is elevated,

lines.text: بسیاری نم باشد در وقت (و اگر در قوس بود) دلالت کند بر توسط باران و
lines.en: there will be much moisture in its time. (And if it is in Sagittarius), it indicates moderate rain and

lines.text: جمعیت اهل طاعت و بیع دواب و نیکی حال عوام و حرارت هوا در وقت و طلب امور
lines.en: the gathering of the people of obedience, and the selling of beasts of burden, and the good condition of the common people, and the heat of the weather in its time, and the seeking of matters

lines.text: دینی و رفتن مردم بدار القضاء و اسانی وضع حمل و مصالحه میان مردم و ایمنی مسافران
lines.en: of religion, and the going of people to the house of judgment, and the ease of pregnancy, and reconciliation among people, and the safety of travelers,

lines.text: و خلاصی محبوسان و تردد حکام و میل مردم بعلوم اگر مشتری مستعلی بود توسط
lines.en: and the release of prisoners, and the coming and going of rulers, and the inclination of people to sciences. If Jupiter is elevated, moderate

lines.text: باران و نم باشد در وقت و اگر قمر مستعلی باشد جستن بادها باشد و افزونی اب
lines.en: rain and moisture will be in its time, and if the Moon is elevated, there will be the blowing of winds and the increase of water

lines.text: رودخانها (مقارنه قمر با مشتری در مثلثه خاکی) دلالت کند بر صلاح حال عامه و
lines.en: of rivers. (The conjunction of the Moon with Jupiter in the earthy triplicity) indicates the goodness of the condition of the common people and

lines.text: قوت ایشان و زیادتی سرما در وقت و افت رسیدن باشراف و اکابر (و اگر در ثور
lines.en: their strength, and the increase of cold in its season, and the arrival of calamity to the nobles and great ones. (And if it is in Taurus,

lines.text: باشد) دلالت کند بر قوة و جمعیت عامه و بزرگزادگان و ایمنی راهها و رسیدن
lines.en: it indicates the strength and gathering of the common people and the high-born, and the safety of the roads, and the arrival

lines.text: کاروانها و اوردن بردها و فراخی نعمت و راحتی طایقین و امدن اخبار و رسل و کثرت
lines.en: of caravans, and the bringing of captives, and the abundance of blessings, and the comfort of the obedient, and the coming of news and messengers, and the multitude

lines.text: دواب و اسانی وضع حمل و امدن باران در وقت و تشویش در بابل و قحط در فارس اگر
lines.en: of beasts of burden, and the ease of pregnancy, and the coming of rain in its time, and disturbance in Babylon, and famine in Fars. If

lines.text: مشتری مستعلی بود کمی باران و اب بود و اگر قمر مستعلی بود کثرت باران بود در وقت
lines.en: Jupiter is elevated, there will be little rain and water, and if the Moon is elevated, there will be a multitude of rain in its time,

lines.text: و تشویش و اضطراب در فارس و قحط و افت در روم (و اگر در سنبله بود) دلالت
lines.en: and disturbance and anxiety in Fars, and famine and calamity in Rome. (And if it is in Virgo), it indicates

lines.text: کند بر امدن باران در وقت و کثرت ابر و نم و زحمت بزرگان و اهل دیوان و حکام
lines.en: the coming of rain in its time, and the multitude of clouds and moisture, and trouble for the great ones and the people of the divan and rulers,

lines.text: و نیکی زراعت و بیع ماکولات و امدن قافله و کاروان و نیکی حال عامه و فراخی نعمتها
lines.en: and the goodness of agriculture and the selling of edibles, and the coming of caravans and convoys, and the goodness of the condition of the common people, and the abundance of blessings.

sections.en: Conjunction of Jupiter and the Moon

summary.headline: Jupiter–Moon Conjunction Omens
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Jupiter and the Moon, covering its effects in Leo, Sagittarius, the earthy triplicity, Taurus, and Virgo on rain, weather, agriculture, trade, travelers, rulers, commoners, pregnancy, and famine. Specific omens include disturbances in Babylon and Fars and calamity in Rome.
